description: Key custody for the IronSecurity stack: one interface over private keys held in software, a PKCS#11 token or HSM, a TPM 2.0, Windows CNG or AWS KMS, with a policy for which of those a host accepts. A library; it is not an information system.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.bearing: IronKeys is how a caller reaches a private key wherever it is kept, and its custody policy decides whether a host accepts software keys, only non-exportable keys, only local hardware, or only providers whose operator declares a FIPS 140 validation.

compliance.gap: IronKeys creates keys only in a TPM or Windows CNG and deletes them only in CNG; generating keys elsewhere, rotation, backup and revocation are the caller's. A provider's validation is the operator's declaration, which IronKeys records but cannot check.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.bearing: IronKeys signs and agrees keys, in a device or service or through IronCrypto.

compliance.reason: IronKeys computes digests and encodes signatures with IronCrypto, which is not CMVP validated, and software keys use IronCrypto throughout. A token, TPM or KMS may perform the private-key operation in a validated module, but IronKeys cannot establish that it does.

controls.title: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems
controls.bearing: IronKeys is how a caller reaches a private key wherever it is kept, under a custody policy the host sets.

compliance.gap: Key generation outside a TPM or Windows CNG, rotation, backup and revocation are the caller's, and a provider's validation is a declaration IronKeys cannot check.

controls.title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI
controls.bearing: IronKeys performs or requests the private-key operations that protect data.

compliance.reason: IronCrypto, which IronKeys uses for digests, encodings and software keys, is not CMVP validated, and IronKeys cannot establish that a device or service it reaches is.
